critique.evidence: Measured performance is demo-ready across all three viewports: LCP is 1,288 ms desktop, 1,156 ms tablet, and 308 ms mobile; FCP is 52–72 ms; TTFB is 1.5–7.5 ms. CLS is excellent on desktop/mobile (0.0011/0) and acceptable on tablet (0.0478). No horizontal overflow, browser failures, request failures, or long-frame samples were recorded. Tablet/mobile frame timing held near 16.67 ms, while desktop averaged a weaker 19.31 ms with a 33.4 ms worst frame. The main constraint is payload size: 1,314,034 transfer bytes, including 1,148,910 JS bytes, across 17 requests.
critique.fix: Reduce the roughly 1.15 MB JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting, tree-shaking, and deferred loading of non-thesis screens. Profile desktop rendering to bring the 19.31 ms average frame below 16.7 ms, and investigate the tablet-only CLS of 0.0478.
